title: The NROL-16 patch and Ron Pandolfi

tellings.quote: continued into the 21st century. In a presentation, former CIA officer John Ramirez described one particular case, the 2005 launch of NROL 16.

plain: The 2005 launch of NROL-16, a satellite mission of the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, came with a mission patch, an embroidered emblem, that ties in to a man named Ron Pandolfi. Michels relays this from a presentation by John Ramirez, a former CIA officer, who described the case as a sign that this kind of hidden symbolism continued into the 21st century.
